actions.name: kicking
actions.text: a person swings one leg forward to kick another person standing in front
paraphrases: a person lifts the right foot quickly toward another person's body
two people face each other as one kicks the other with a leg
a person kicks forward at another person, who steps or bends back
actions.motion: The actor stands facing the partner, shifts weight onto the left leg, and swings the right leg forward and up so the foot reaches the partner's legs or torso. The actor's arms may move out for balance and the torso leans back slightly. The partner's body jerks back or bends at the point of contact and may step backward. The actor's leg then returns to the floor.

phases.start: two people face each other, actor shifts weight
phases.middle: actor's leg swings forward into partner, partner recoils
phases.end: actor's foot returns to the floor

confusable_with.name: kicking_something
confusable_with.visible_difference: kicking_something has no second person reacting

confusable_with.name: step_on_foot
confusable_with.visible_difference: step_on_foot lifts the foot only a little and brings it down onto the partner's foot

confusable_with.name: side_kick
confusable_with.visible_difference: side_kick extends the leg sideways and has no partner

actions.name: pushing
actions.text: a person pushes another person's chest with both hands, moving them backward
paraphrases: a person thrusts both arms forward into another person, who steps back
two people face each other and one shoves the other away with hands
a person extends both arms against another person's upper body and pushes
actions.motion: The actor faces the partner, bends both elbows, then extends both arms forward quickly so the hands contact the partner's chest or shoulders. The actor's torso leans forward behind the push. The partner's torso tilts back and the partner takes one or more steps backward, increasing the distance between them. The actor's arms then lower.

phases.start: two people close together facing each other
phases.middle: actor's arms extend into partner's chest

confusable_with.name: punch_slap
confusable_with.visible_difference: punch_slap uses one fast arm toward the head without moving the partner's feet

confusable_with.name: knock_over
confusable_with.visible_difference: knock_over ends with the partner falling to the floor

confusable_with.name: hugging
confusable_with.visible_difference: hugging wraps the arms around the partner and brings bodies closer

actions.name: pat_on_back
actions.text: a person taps another person's back or shoulder repeatedly with one hand
paraphrases: a person reaches an arm around another person and pats their back
two people stand side by side while one taps the other's shoulder
a person lightly hits another person's upper back several times with a hand
actions.motion: The actor stands beside or slightly behind the partner and raises the right arm so the hand reaches the partner's upper back or shoulder. The hand moves up and down in small repeated taps while the actor's arm stays bent. The partner stands mostly still with little body movement. The actor's arm then lowers.

phases.start: actor beside or behind partner, arm lifts
phases.middle: repeated small taps on partner's back or shoulder

confusable_with.name: hugging
confusable_with.visible_difference: hugging has both people's arms around each other with chests together

confusable_with.name: touch_pocket
confusable_with.visible_difference: touch_pocket reaches to the partner's hip area instead of the back

confusable_with.name: punch_slap
confusable_with.visible_difference: punch_slap is a single fast strike from the front with the partner recoiling

actions.name: point_finger
actions.text: a person points a straight arm at another person standing in front
paraphrases: a person extends the right arm toward another person's face and holds
two people face each other as one aims a straight arm at the other
a person raises one arm and holds it extended toward another person
actions.motion: The actor faces the partner and lifts the right arm forward until it is straight, with the hand aimed at the partner's face or chest. The arm is held extended and may jab forward a few times. The partner stands mostly still or leans back slightly. The actor's arm then lowers.

phases.middle: actor's straight arm held toward partner

confusable_with.name: point_to_something
confusable_with.visible_difference: point_to_something has no second person in the pointing direction

confusable_with.name: shoot_with_gun
confusable_with.visible_difference: shoot_with_gun often uses both hands joined and the partner raises arms or falls

confusable_with.name: punch_slap
confusable_with.visible_difference: punch_slap moves the arm fast into contact with the partner

actions.name: hugging
actions.text: two people step together and wrap their arms around each other's bodies
paraphrases: two people embrace with arms around each other's backs and chests close
a person and another person hold each other closely with both arms
two people move in close and put their arms around one another
actions.motion: Both people move toward each other until their torsos are very close or touching. Each raises both arms and wraps them around the other's back or shoulders, so their hands end behind the other person's body. They hold the embrace for a while with little movement, possibly swaying slightly. They then release and step apart.

phases.middle: arms wrapped around each other, torsos together

confusable_with.name: pat_on_back
confusable_with.visible_difference: pat_on_back uses only one person's single arm with repeated taps

confusable_with.name: support_somebody
confusable_with.visible_difference: support_somebody has one arm around the partner while both walk side by side

confusable_with.name: pushing
confusable_with.visible_difference: pushing extends the arms and moves the partner away

actions.name: giving_object
actions.text: a person extends a hand to another person, who reaches out to take it
paraphrases: a person holds out the right hand and another person's hand meets it
two people reach toward each other until their hands meet, then withdraw
a person passes something forward as another person reaches and receives it
actions.motion: The actor extends the right arm forward toward the partner at about waist or chest height. The partner raises a hand and reaches forward so both hands meet between them briefly. Then both arms pull back, with the partner's hand returning toward their own body. The action happens once.

phases.start: two people facing each other, actor's arm extends

confusable_with.name: exchange_things
confusable_with.visible_difference: exchange_things has both people giving, with two hand meetings or both arms extended

confusable_with.name: shaking_hands
confusable_with.visible_difference: shaking_hands keeps the hands joined and moving up and down

confusable_with.name: grab_stuff
confusable_with.visible_difference: grab_stuff has one person snatching quickly while the other pulls back

actions.name: touch_pocket
actions.text: a person reaches a hand toward another person's hip or pocket area
paraphrases: a person moves the right hand to the side of another person's waist
two people stand close as one reaches toward the other's pocket
a person sneaks a hand toward another person's hip from beside them
actions.motion: The actor stands beside or behind the partner and moves the right hand down and toward the partner's hip, where it stays briefly. The actor's torso may lean slightly toward the partner. The partner mostly stands still, or turns and looks back and moves a hand toward the hip. The actor's hand then withdraws.

confusable_with.name: reach_into_pocket
confusable_with.visible_difference: reach_into_pocket uses the person's own hip with no partner

confusable_with.name: pat_on_back
confusable_with.visible_difference: pat_on_back reaches higher to the back or shoulder and taps

confusable_with.name: grab_stuff
confusable_with.visible_difference: grab_stuff reaches toward the partner's hands from the front

actions.name: shaking_hands
actions.text: two people join right hands between them and move them up and down
paraphrases: two people face each other and clasp right hands, shaking them briefly
a person takes another person's right hand and moves it up and down
two people reach out right hands, join them, and pump a few times
actions.motion: Both people face each other and extend their right arms forward so their right hands meet in the space between them at about waist height. The joined hands move up and down a few times together. Their torsos stay upright and close. Then the hands release and both arms return to their sides.

phases.start: two people facing, right arms extend
phases.middle: joined right hands move up and down

confusable_with.name: giving_object
confusable_with.visible_difference: giving_object has the hands meet only briefly without up-down shaking

confusable_with.name: high-five
confusable_with.visible_difference: high-five meets the hands quickly above head height

confusable_with.name: rock-paper-scissors
confusable_with.visible_difference: rock-paper-scissors keeps hands apart and bobs them separately

actions.name: walking_towards
actions.text: two people walk toward each other from a distance until they are close
paraphrases: two people approach each other with walking steps and stop near each other
a person and another person walk forward and meet in the middle
two people start apart and step closer together until face to face
actions.motion: The two people start apart and both walk forward with alternating leg steps and arm swings, facing each other. The distance between their bodies shrinks steadily. They stop when they are close and facing each other. The torsos stay upright throughout.

phases.start: two people apart, facing each other

confusable_with.name: walking_apart
confusable_with.visible_difference: walking_apart has the distance increasing as they walk away

confusable_with.name: follow
confusable_with.visible_difference: follow has both people walking in the same direction one behind the other

confusable_with.name: staggering
confusable_with.visible_difference: staggering is one person with uneven swaying steps

actions.name: walking_apart
actions.text: two people start close together and walk away from each other
paraphrases: two people turn and walk in opposite directions, getting farther apart
a person and another person separate by walking away from one another
two people step away from each other until there is a large gap
actions.motion: The two people start close together, then turn away from each other and walk with alternating leg steps and arm swings. Each moves in roughly the opposite direction, so the distance between their bodies grows steadily. They stop or leave the view far apart. The torsos stay upright throughout.

confusable_with.name: walking_towards
confusable_with.visible_difference: walking_towards has the distance shrinking as they approach

confusable_with.name: follow
confusable_with.visible_difference: follow keeps a similar distance while both walk the same way

confusable_with.name: pushing
confusable_with.visible_difference: pushing separates them by a hand thrust, with only the partner stepping back
